description.text: Teaching ObjectivesAfter graduation you will be qualified senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in the areas of production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprises trade, and administrative management and training and so forth.Main coursesChinese Culture and History; Fundamental Law; Introduction to Computing; General Chemistry; Introduction to Aerospace; Probability and Statistics; Linear Algebra; Programming Design Lab; Material Mechanics; Analog electronic circuits; Computer Aided Drafting(AutoCAD)Laboratory ofShenyang Aerospace University InternshipMetalworking, mechanical drawing, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, computer measurement and control technology of comprehensive practice, professional practice, professional design, graduation design etc.Degree AwardedBachelor Degree of Engineering.Future CareerAfter graduation you can be comprehensive senior engineers to design mechatronics system, do manufacture or develop new technology in the enterprises or research institute. You can also go to university to make search in the major.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Passport first page.(2) Empty visa page of passport(3) High school diploma and Chinese translation(4) Proof of English ability(5) Medical reports(6) No criminal record proof(7) English self-introduction video(8) Applicants who have studied or lived in China need to provide other documents according to the actual situation

requirements.text: 1.Under 25 years of age, high school graduate or equivalent qualification with 12 years of education background.
